[USER] User is looking to improve their 5K time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Interval training is an excellent way to improve 5K performance by increasing speed, endurance, and overall running efficiency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended interval training workouts include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **1. Fartlek Intervals**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, alternate between 1-2 minutes of fast running (around 5K pace) and 2-3 minutes of active recovery, repeat for 20-30 minutes, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **2. 400m Interval Workout**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run 400m at a fast pace (around 1-2 minutes), walk or jog for 200m to recover, repeat for 3-5 sets, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **3. Hill Repeats**: Find a route with a gradual incline (around 1-2 miles long), warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run up the hill at high intensity (around 1-2 minutes), walk or jog back down to recover, repeat for 3-5 sets, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **4. 800m Interval Workout**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run 800m at a fast pace (around 2-3 minutes), walk or jog for 400m to recover, repeat for 2-3 sets, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **5. Pyramid Intervals**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run 200m at a fast pace (around 30-45 seconds), recover for 200m, run 400m at a fast pace (around 1-2 minutes), recover for 400m, run 600m at a fast pace (around 2-3 minutes), recover for 600m, run 400m at a fast pace (around 1-2 minutes), recover for 400m, run 200m at a fast pace (around 30-45 seconds), cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **6. Proportional Intervals**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run at a fast pace for 1 minute (around 5K pace), recover for 2 minutes, run at a fast
